scope: Fix final rendered heading sizes and unify distributed alignment with published BlockCraft 0.11.21 typography. Not full release certification.

versions.note: Queried configured desktop npm registry again before changes; desktop declaration/lock already advanced to 0.11.21, installation still 0.11.17. Desktop dependencies not modified by this task.

upstream.note: Migration entry says pending release; actual published artifact and heading theme determine supported behavior.

changes: Paragraph-family page decoration passes the already styled after span into the mobile link decorator, retaining semantic size and paragraph scale before per-run overrides.
Distributed alignment no longer applies a separate legacy heading array or overwrites per-run font sizes; its layout uses the same resolved font sizes as normal alignment.
Clarified applyParagraph=false precondition: the base must already retain the paragraph/heading style.
Added permanent complete-page RenderParagraph assertions with expected values generated by published paragraph/inline typography readers.

coverage: Final effective font sizes per UTF-16 character, including TextScaler and inherited nested span styles.
Paragraph fs overriding semantic heading size, paragraph pfs and inline t:fs applied once, t:px overriding paragraph base, legacy px/em and compact-key precedence.
Actual multi-line mixed styles and link runs; asserts selections span multiple line tops, including distributed slicing.
Empty heading placeholders with semantic and explicit default typography.
Mode transitions preserve document JSON and publish no local block changes.
